explanation: Store a trie edge per next character and an explicit terminal flag at complete keys.
correctness: The path represents a key's exact characters. Only its terminal flag denotes complete-key membership, so shared prefixes never create false complete keys.
walkthrough: Insert https://a/b: create missing character links and mark its final node, returning true. Insert https://a next: its character path exists, but its final node was not a complete key, so return true. Repeating https://a/b returns false. Extending it to https://a/b/c marks a different complete key and returns true.
edgeCases: shorter prefix inserted after longer key
timeComplexity: O(L) time per insertion of a length-L key.
spaceComplexity: O(P) storage for P distinct stored prefixes.
